title: Payments disappear, but nobody gets warned
story: An unintended routing configuration error disrupts emulated satellite backhaul for commercial payment terminals and ATMs.
human_decisions: Commander approves PB-10 advisory to merchant acquirers despite absence of statutory duty.
Commander authorizes PB-06 microwave routing until configuration audit completes.

objective.what: Commercial hub CHN-02 restores payment terminal transactions by failing over from corrupted satellite route to clean microwave link.

schedule.what: Satellite operator applies routine maintenance routing update.
M1 detects sharp drop in payment transaction completion rate.
M3 evaluates failure pattern and classifies outage as non-malicious equipment fault.
Mobile operator confirms widespread retail payment failures in commercial district.
Gap Analyst audits obligation to warn downstream financial institutions and merchants.
Satellite operator isolates misconfigured routing table entry on primary gateway link.
Commander approves PB-10 merchant advisory drafted by Gap Analyst.
Mobile operator fails over commercial hub CHN-02 to clean microwave backup.
M1 verifies payment transaction recovery over microwave backup path.
